prompts.name: home
prompts.prompt:
DshanControl industrial touch HMI redesign, Chinese interface, white and engineering blue. Baseline 1024×600 logical pixels. Precise 2D flat app screenshot, no hardware bezel, no perspective, no photographic machinery, no neon or sci-fi. Industrial restraint: white #FFFFFF header/work surfaces, cool mist #F2F6FB canvas, cobalt #1260D6 active states and primary actions, pale blue #EAF2FF navigation background, dark ink #18324F text, hairline #D9E3EF dividers, amber #B87612 caution and restrained red #CF4555 alarms. A strong architectural constant is a pale blue left navigation rail 140px wide, white top bar 52px high. Header: blue square monogram D, DshanControl wordmark, compact descriptor 工业控制桌面, right status 样例数据 and time 14:32:08. Rail: 运行总览 / 现场总线 / 网络通信 / 设备监控 / 告警记录 / 系统设置; six clear line icons with labels, selected item cobalt filled rectangular pill with 6px corner radius. Bottom of rail 工程预览. Neutral geometric sans-serif with Noto Sans CJK-like Chinese, tabular numeric values, body text 14-16 logical px, page title 23px, buttons 44px tall, minimum 44px touch targets, generous 16px section gutters but fit real 600px height. Main 236px-tall wide panel is the memorable centerpiece, labelled 通信链路: a disciplined schematic from three stacked field-device blocks 温控模块 / 采集模块 / 驱动单元, via named lines Modbus RTU / CANopen / EtherCAT, to a blue outlined central DshanControl gateway rectangle, then to right two destinations 本地网络 and 数据平台, solid blue/green connections, small directional markers and restrained device line icons. Center gateway details 采集周期 1000 ms, 数据点 128, 状态 运行中. This is a flat engineering communication schematic, not an image of a factory. Lower row 170px tall: left 60% width white panel 设备趋势 with precise readable axes and two sparing blue trend lines 温度 36.8 °C and 压力 0.62 MPa over 60秒; right40% 活动告警 with two tidy amber rows 通信响应超时 and 温度接近阈值 and a small 查看全部 affordance. Bottom 24px quiet status footer: CPU 18% | 内存 42% | 存储 26% | 数据刷新 1秒. Ensure top summary, full topology and lower panels plus footer all fit in 600 logical px. White dominant 80%, blue highlights about15%, black/navy typography. This image will be shown directly to the user as the proposed redesign; extremely polished and legible Chinese labels.
